output.title: Renovated furnished studio with character in historic Clausen
output.description:
This studio apartment offers 38 m² of thoughtfully renovated living space within a historic stone building located in the Clausen valley. The interior features a characterful blend of rustic and modern elements, highlighted by exposed wooden beams and a warm wood floor that enhance the ambiance.

The main room is designed for functionality and comfort, furnished with a double bed and compact seating area. A modern kitchenette occupies a corner of the room, equipped with a two-burner cooktop, compact fridge, stainless steel sink, and practical cabinetry, optimizing the available space.

The bathroom has been recently updated, featuring a clean, modern design with white tiling, a shower stall, and a compact vanity. The property's exterior retains authentic historic charm, reflective of its setting on a narrow street in Clausen, known for its atmospheric old-world environment.
